title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: approved Field Service time updates project task progress
summary: The roadmap facts, integration controls and licensing statements are supported. The approval guidance omits a required qualification: Project Approver Admin bypasses approver validation but still requires security-role access to related tables such as Project.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope; controls[0].note; rationale
claims.claim: Approved Field Service time contributes to Project Operations WBS task progress when the integration is enabled and time is captured against a project task.
claims.quote: Approved Field Service time now contributes directly to task-level WBS execution metrics in Project Operations when time is captured against a project task.

claims.quote: "status": "Launched", "statusKey": "launched"

claims.quote: "targetDate": "July CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap gives no preview date.
claims.quote: "previewDate": null

claims.claim: The release phase is General Availability.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability"]

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; What's changing; Why it matters
claims.claim: The feature is enabled automatically where the integration is enabled, supporting defaultState on.
claims.quote: This feature is only available when the Field Service and Project Operations integration is enabled. ... Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

claims.claim: Execution calculations occur on leaf tasks and roll up to summary tasks and the project root.
claims.quote: Because these calculations occur at the leaf task level, their impact rolls up automatically to summary tasks and the project root.

claims.claim: The enhancement introduces no new execution logic or formulas and applies native Project Operations rules to approved field labour.
claims.quote: This enhancement doesn't introduce new execution logic or formulas. It enables existing Project Operations WBS effort tracking behavior to include Field Service execution when time is captured against project tasks.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Learn says approved time entries are the only signal used to update WBS task execution progress.
claims.quote: Approved time entries are the only signal used to update task execution progress in the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS).
claims.fix: Narrow 'only approved entries move task progress' to 'Only approved time contributes actual effort to task progress.' The cited project-tracking-overview page also says updating Remaining Effort during reprojection recalculates EAC and progress percentage; add that qualification to the absolute statement in What's changing.

claims.claim: Approving time reduces remaining effort by the approved hours.
claims.quote: The system reduces the remaining effort based on the approved hours.

claims.claim: Approval automatically recalculates effort completed.
claims.quote: The project automatically recalculates metrics such as effort completed, percent complete, and estimate at completion.

claims.quote: The project automatically recalculates metrics such as effort completed, percent complete, and estimate at completion.

claims.quote: The project automatically recalculates metrics such as effort completed, percent complete, and estimate at completion.

claims.claim: Effort tracking and Cost tracking views show progress at project root, summary and leaf task levels.
claims.quote: Tracking data in the Effort tracking and Cost tracking views shows the progress and cost consumption at the project root node, summary tasks, and leaf node tasks levels.

claims.claim: Submitted but unapproved time does not affect task effort completed.
claims.quote: Submitted but unapproved time entries don't affect project task effort completed hours, project progress, or project actual hours until approval.

claims.claim: Technicians submit Field Service time and it flows to Project Operations.
claims.quote: After technicians enter and submit time in Field Service for work associated with a project or project task, the time entries flow to Project Operations.

claims.claim: The time entry page describes no new data store for this behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: Field Service Project Operations approved time task progress data storage new data store. Read project-operations-integration-time in full; its description of time-entry flow, project progress and financial impact names no new data store.

claims.where: Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Open questions
claims.claim: Time entries currently do not appear in work order-level financial summaries or totals.
claims.quote: Currently, time entries don't appear in work order-level financial summaries or work order financial totals.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: The time entry page specifies project team membership and a Project Approver Admin field set to Yes.
claims.quote: To approve time entries, a user must be a team member on the project and have the Project Approver Admin field on their team member record set to Yes.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The approvals security page calls the team-member field Project Approver.
claims.quote: a user must be a team member on the project and have the Project Approver field on their team member record set to yes.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: The Project Approver Admin security role bypasses team-member validation and allows approval of all entries without a related-table access qualification.
claims.quote: You must have access to the relevant related tables, such as Project, via security roles assigned to you.
claims.fix: Add after the approval-role sentence: 'Approvers, including users with Project Approver Admin, must also have access to relevant related tables such as Project through their assigned security roles.' This qualification is stated at https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/project-operations/approvals/approvals-security.

claims.claim: Time off entered in Field Service does not affect project financials.
claims.quote: Time off entered in Field Service doesn't affect the project's financials.

claims.claim: Field Service scheduling changes do not update project task dates.
claims.quote: Changes made during scheduling in Field Service don't update project task dates.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Managing project tasks in Project Operations requires a Project Operations licence.
claims.quote: Use Project Operations to manage tasks as it requires a Project Operations license.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; controls[1].note; Cost and licensing; Governance controls
claims.claim: The user installing the integration package needs at least one Project Operations licence.
claims.quote: To download and install the Dynamics 365 Field Service and Project Operations integration package, the installing user must have at least one Project Operations license.

claims.claim: The entitlement model is included in the Project Operations licence already required for task management.
claims.quote: Use Project Operations to manage tasks as it requires a Project Operations license.

claims.claim: The project task and work order integration page names no licence or meter.
claims.quote: Searched: Project Operations Field Service approved time task progress licensing price meter; read project-operations-integration-project-task in full. It describes task progress, actuals and task-based billing but names no licence or meter.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: No separate price or meter is published for this approved-time tracking behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: Project Operations Field Service approved time task progress licensing price meter; Dynamics 365 Project Operations licensing Field Service integration effort tracking licence meter pricing. Read task, time, projects and install pages; no feature-specific price or meter found.

claims.claim: The integration package includes a recurring flow running under its installing user.
claims.quote: The Field Service and Project Operations Integration package includes a flow that runs regularly under the user who installs the package.

claims.claim: Microsoft asks administrators to confirm appropriate Power Automate licensing for the installing user and recurring flow usage.
claims.quote: Review the Types of Power Automate licenses and confirm that the installing user and recurring flow usage are licensed appropriately for your environment.

claims.claim: Integration installation and enablement require a Field Service administrator or system administrator role.
claims.quote: Prerequisites: You have a Field Service administrator role or system administrator role.

claims.claim: The install page specifies Field Service minimum version 8.8.150.63.
claims.quote: You have Field Service minimum version 8.8.150.63.

claims.claim: The install page specifies Project Operations minimum version 4.172.3603.1.
claims.quote: You have Project Operations minimum version 4.172.3603.1.

claims.claim: Creating work orders from a project task requires leaf-level WBS tasks.
claims.quote: To create work orders from a project task in Project Operations, the project must meet the following criteria: ... The project tasks are created at the leaf task level in the work breakdown structure (WBS).

claims.claim: Field Service > Settings > Features > Field Service Integration with Project Operations reaches the integration toggle.
claims.quote: In Field Service, go to the Settings area. On the Features tab, turn on the Field Service Integration with Project Operations toggle.

claims.claim: Microsoft documents no API operation that sets the Field Service Integration with Project Operations toggle.
claims.quote: Searched: Field Service Project Operations integration toggle API msdyn_fieldservicesetting enable integration project operations; enable toggle Dataverse Web API entity attribute. Read install page; searched entire Field Service Setting reference for project and integration, with no matching column.

claims.claim: Power Platform admin center > Manage > Dynamics 365 Apps > Dynamics 365 Field Service and Project Operations Integration reaches the integration package.
claims.quote: Select Manage > Dynamics 365 Apps > Dynamics 365 Field Service and Project Operations Integration. Select Install and follow the prompts.
claims.fix: Extend controls[1].ui.path to 'Manage > Dynamics 365 Apps > Dynamics 365 Field Service and Project Operations Integration > Install', as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/dynamics365/field-service/project-operations-integration-install.

claims.claim: pac application install --environment-id <environment-id> --application-name <application-name> is documented for installing Dataverse applications from Microsoft Marketplace generally.
claims.quote: Commands for listing and installing available Dataverse applications from Microsoft Marketplace. ... pac application install --environment-id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 --application-name MSFT_EmployeeIdeas

claims.claim: No separately documented setting excludes approved Field Service time from WBS effort tracking while retaining the integration.
claims.quote: Searched: Project Operations Field Service approved time WBS effort tracking separate setting disable. Read task, time and Project time task tracking pages; the latter controls real-time versus delayed synchronization, not exclusion of approved Field Service time.

claims.claim: The Approvals view contains submitted time awaiting approval.
claims.quote: You can find these records in the Approvals view under the Projects area of the sitemap. ... Go to the Approvals page and select Expenses, Time, Material Usage, or Recalls.

claims.claim: The checklist tells readers to inventory project approvers and Project Approver Admin role holders, but no control row covers approval permissions.
claims.quote: List the project approvers and the people holding the Project Approver Admin role ...; controls contains only integration enablement and package installation.
claims.fix: Remove the checklist bullet beginning 'List the project approvers and the people holding the Project Approver Admin role'; it has no corresponding controls row. Do not add a row as part of this correction.

claims.claim: The effort tracking page applies to Project Operations Integrated with ERP and Project Operations Core.
claims.quote: Applies To: Project Operations Integrated with ERP, Project Operations Core
